Instagram Video Editor Desktop — Initial Release

- Launches the first version of a desktop tool for automatic Instagram video editing.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; edit with natural language instructions.
- Supports cropping, adding trending music, captions, and quick export to Instagram-ready formats.
- Handles authentication, session management, error handling, and cloud rendering automatically.
- Offers user-friendly workflows for creators seeking fast, simple Instagram video edits without complex software.
